title: 第14章  你们若是不能杀死我，就要被我杀死
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
陆渊推开大门，径直朝着院内走去。

    他眸光颤动，在夜色中泛着金芒，心中战意升腾。

    如渊似海的灵力在经脉中急剧压缩，凝聚为澄澈灵晶，将所有气息收敛在内，不泄露一丝一毫。

    陆渊此行是为杀妖而来。

    在他的视线中，陈家宅院内妖气冲天而起，少说也有七八十只妖魔。

    万一里面那些妖魔被他的气息所震慑，提前溜了，那这趟就亏大了。

    来时他遇到了撤退的苏定安，根据对方所说，里面大多数妖魔都是初境气息。

    面对如此阵容，吴守信一个镇魔卫根本撑不了多久。

    但对陆渊来说，这根本不算什么。

    即便他不知道血妖的谋划，甚至都不知道那只血妖藏在哪里。

    但无所谓，他只是来杀妖的。

    轰——

    院墙轰然爆开，碎砖飞溅，一道人影裹挟着烟尘中踏入庭院。

    一众血奴纷纷扭头看来，灰白的眼珠盯着那道身影，连对吴守信的攻势都慢了几分。

    陈连山也被吓了一跳，脸上的笑容变得僵硬。

    看着那道身影一步步走出烟尘，他猩红的瞳孔骤然收缩。

    “大人！”

    看清来人后，浑身是血的吴守信大喜过望。

    他靠在墙角，身上伤口不断淌血，连站都站不稳，正用一种难以置信的眼神看着陆渊。

    他想过很多种可能，却唯独没想过救场的人会是陆渊。

    大人？

    陈连山神情微怔，脸色瞬间变得凝重。

    “镇魔司的人？他不应该在北渡口吗？”

    奇怪了！

    血妖大人命那些水伥牵制镇魔司的人，短时间内绝对不可能脱身，怎么会有镇魔卫来此？

    不过还好，宅子周边并没有其它气息，应该是独自前来。

    想到这里，他脸色恢复镇定，嘴角勾起笑容。

    “又是一个镇魔卫？出场挺不错，可惜太蠢了。”

    他负手而立，看向陆渊的眼神就像是在看一个懵懂小辈。

    “这座院子可是血妖大人的布置，你一个人闯进来又能做什么？”

    “这里有四十只初境血奴，就算你是初境，又能撑多久？一炷香？还是两炷香？”

    话音落下，所有的初境血奴齐刷刷将陆渊围了起来。
content_en:
Lu Yuan pushed open the door and walked straight into the courtyard.

    His eyes trembled, glowing golden in the night, and fighting spirit rose in his heart.

    The spiritual power as deep as the sea compressed rapidly in the meridians and condensed into clear spiritual crystals, which contained all the breath without leaking even a trace.

    Lu Yuan came here to kill demons.

    In his sight, the demonic aura soared into the sky in the Chen family residence. There were at least seventy or eighty demons.

    If the demons inside were frightened by his aura and escaped early, then this trip would be a huge loss.

    When he came, he met Su Ding'an who was retreating. According to what he said, most of the demons inside were the auras of the first realm.

    Facing such a lineup, Wu Shouxin could not last long as a demon-suppressing guard.

    But to Lu Yuan, this was nothing.

    Even if he didn't know the blood demon's plan, he didn't even know where the blood demon was hiding.

    But it doesn't matter, he's just here to kill monsters.

    Boom——

    The courtyard wall exploded with a bang, broken bricks flying, and a figure stepped into the courtyard wrapped in smoke and dust.

    All the blood slaves turned their heads to look, their gray eyes staring at that figure, even their attack on Wu Shouxin was a little slower.

    Chen Lianshan was also startled, and the smile on his face became stiff.

    Watching the figure walking out of the smoke step by step, his scarlet pupils suddenly shrank.

    "My lord!"

    After seeing the person clearly, Wu Shouxin, who was covered in blood, was overjoyed.

    He was leaning against the corner, bleeding from the wounds on his body, unable to even stand still, and looking at Lu Yuan with disbelief.

    He thought about many possibilities, but he never thought that Lu Yuan would be the one to save the situation.

    grown ups?

    Chen Lianshan looked slightly startled, and his face instantly became solemn.

    "A man from the Demon Suppression Division? Shouldn't he be at Beidukou?"

    Strange!

    Lord Blood Demon ordered those minions to contain the Demon Suppressing Division. It would be absolutely impossible for them to escape in a short time. Why would the Demon Suppressing Guard come here?

    Fortunately, there was no other smell around the house, so he probably came alone.

    Thinking of this, his face returned to calmness and a smile appeared on his lips.

    "Another demon-suppressing guard? It's a good appearance, but it's too stupid."

    He stood with his hands behind his hands and looked at Lu Yuan as if he were looking at an ignorant junior.

    "This courtyard is arranged by Lord Blood Demon. What can you do if you break in alone?"

    "There are forty first-level blood slaves here. Even if you are the first-level blood slave, how long can you last? One stick of incense? Or two sticks of incense?"

    As soon as he finished speaking, all the first-level blood slaves surrounded Lu Yuan.
title_en: Chapter 14 If you can’t kill me, you will be killed by me
